direct_integrated_joint.torque: Each full output must meet all simultaneously reconstructed case vectors plus separately derived dynamics. Do not replace vector by independent per-axis corner maxima.
direct_integrated_joint.geometry: One same-source fixed housing/paired support/output flange/motor/reducer/brake/encoder/seals/cable and cooling module; actual inner-skin collision check includes complete axial stack.
direct_integrated_joint.serial_carrier: Hip yaw/roll and shoulder multiaxis require true serial intermediate moving bodies and reaction paths; eight pitch components do not constitute whole robot.

proximal_offset_rotary.transmission_force: Tangential force=tau_output/r_output; branch capacity/load sharing not automatically 50/50.
proximal_offset_rotary.geometry: Keep actual joint output shaft/bearings/brake and proximal complete motor/reducer; model gear/belt/shaft full swept path and tension/preload/spacing reaction into carrier. Remote drive does not remove output support or create free torso volume.
proximal_offset_rotary.series_crossing: Transmission crossing upstream axes needs explicit orientation invariant routing or Jacobian coupling; same body label is insufficient.

linear_or_linkage.jacobian: tau=J_length^T*f; each candidate here is single joint parent/child and |dL/dq|. Coupled paths require full matrix at every pose.
linear_or_linkage.force_stroke: F >= |tau|/|dL/dq| with force-speed/duty/tension/compression limits. |dL/dq| approaching zero rejects; eye length/stroke/mounts/rod buckling/end stop/cable or hose bend remain unknown.
linear_or_linkage.shell: Line segment is not actuator package; body/rod/clevis plus fixed and moving mounts need actual volume and continuous sweep check.

minimum_next_native_candidate: One full left hip-knee-fold-ankle leg with real serial hip yaw/roll carrier reserves, thin C15 armor, fixed/output supports and selected complete drive path, plus knee direct vs proximal-offset vs rod alternatives under same axis/load case and explicit torso/shoulder/waist/arms energy-thermal-drive occupancy ledger with serial intermediate carriers. Do not simply retain or scale-delete the 51 old A reserves. Duplicate only after native interfaces and full-pose shell sweep; keep AA3 authority.
